This creates a chain of metabolic interactions where Loperamide indirectly influences Cyp2b6 through its effect on Cyp2c8. The presence of a high score in the pathway indicates a plausible, though indirect, relationship between Loperamide and Cyp2b6, likely through a metabolic pathway involving Cyp2c8.
